newsitem.title: DENMARK: CYCLING-MINALI WINS DENMARK TOUR FIRST STAGE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-MINALI WINS DENMARK TOUR FIRST STAGE.

text.p: Nicola Minali won a closely fought first stage of the Tour of Denmark on Wednesday, narrowly nudging past Australia's Robbie McEwen and fellow Italian Fabrizio Guidi in a last minute spurt.
"I was alone up front away from my Batik team mates, who had problems and were spread out away from each other. I pressed past McEwen and Guidi in a final spurt, winning by a whisker," Minali said.
Guidi won the event last year.
Dane Bjarne Riis, winner of last year's Tour de France and seventh this year, finished the opening stage in seventh place.
The stage took place over 163.6 kms between Horsens and Esbjerg on the Jutland peninsula in west Denmark.
